## Description

Optimize the execution trajectory by balancing expected market impact against price-risk during the execution horizon.

## Where it may fit

Large parent orders where market impact and execution risk are material.

## Vehicles

Institutional equity, futures and FX execution desks.

## Required data

Parent order size/deadline, volatility, liquidity/impact estimates, price path, risk-aversion parameter and fills.

## Caveats

Model calibration is instrument- and regime-specific; theoretical optimality depends on assumptions about impact and price dynamics.
